explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/978: the page notes that the no-fixed-(k-2)-power-divisor assumption, which Erdős left implicit, is necessary. This variant formalises that necessity. It negates the version that excludes only fixed (k-1)-th power divisors, and it is witnessed by e.g. degree 6, where 2^4 can be a fixed divisor. The negation is placed correctly and carries a formal proof link. Faithful as a variant.
